highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 gains upstream fixes for clipped paths, glyph replay and Graphite readback.
highlights_body: These updates retain Skia milestone 156 and leave managed wrappers and generated bindings unchanged.

bullets.detail: Corrects Ganesh device-space path bounds and coverage-mask subset clamping, plus Graphite clip-key packing and wedge miter bounds. Convex anti-aliased rasterization fixes prevent run-buffer overflow around clip gaps; custom builds defining SK_LEGACY_ALPHA_RUNS do not enable that new raster behavior.

Validates serialized Slug positions, transforms, bounds and flags, preserves creation-time rounding, and bounds direct-mask offsets. Ganesh and Graphite reject unsuitable replay data when glyph-atlas bilinear sampling is unavailable, retaining rendering fallbacks.
Fixes the destination pixel-size mismatch when transferring an alpha texture to an RGBx color type, preventing incorrect row stepping and unwritten destination bytes.
